root_cause.text: The devlink reinit down path (ice_devlink_reinit_down()) is missing a call to ice_deinit_hw() after a previous commit removed it from ice_deinit_dev(), breaking the symmetry with ice_devlink_reinit_up() which calls ice_init_hw(), causing ice_init_hw() to fail with -EBUSY because control queues remain initialized, leading to a NULL pointer dereference during driver removal.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that commit 1390b8b3d2be removed ice_deinit_hw() from ice_deinit_dev(), resulting in ice_devlink_reinit_down() no longer calling ice_deinit_hw(), while ice_devlink_reinit_up() still calls ice_init_hw(). This imbalance causes ice_init_hw() to fail with -EBUSY, confirmed by the call trace showing a NULL pointer dereference in ice_unload/ice_remove after ice_init_hw fails.
